pointers.sentence: It makes two notes of the entry and leaves its names where they are (`django/urls/resolvers.py:URLResolver._populate`).
The last piece is the pattern's name; the pieces before it are a chain of namespaces, followed one at a time from the root resolver (`django/urls/base.py:reverse`).
The name can then be reversed there in the ordinary way, with the parameters of the way down among its own (`django/urls/resolvers.py:get_ns_resolver`).
On a page served from one of an application's instances, a link written with the application's namespace therefore leads to that same instance (`django/template/defaulttags.py:URLNode.render`).

The admin's views set it to the name of their site, which is the instance namespace `AdminSite.urls` gives the site's URLs ([The admin](../admin.md)) (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.index`).
